text:
Sebastian Kolowa, Bishop of the North-Eastern (Usambara-Digo) Diocese, succeeded Stefano Moshi as presiding bishop of the Evangelical Lutheran Church in Tanzania, taking over around 1975–76. My earlier answer of Samson Mushemba was wrong. As I recall, Mushemba came after Kolowa in the late 1980s. This is from memory, and I haven't checked it against a source.

CONFIDENCE: 80
